entries.source_evidence: Day279 roughly10:20AM at first staffed eastbound Caer Veylan–Eastwatch freight lay-by. V's exact in-character instruction in reply to the independent Station Kestrel supply worker KN-S1's warning of nonconsensual painful treatment of eleven persons: "This is also the Veyren Military… not sure if we want to make an enemy of the whole state. But we will hear you out and see if we can help or not." This explicitly authorizes hearing evidence and possible evaluation, NOT accepting a rescue, traveling to Kestrel, attacking/defying Commonwealth personnel, paying a deposit, abandoning Harrow & Pike escort, or volunteering V's speech beyond player words. The supply worker acknowledges genuine risks of antagonizing Veyran military without pretending an independent Veyran authority can guarantee immunity. To avoid casual official eavesdropping, the worker leads V and independently accompanying Cirren a few steps behind V's own carriage, within sight of Mara/Fenar; no stealth check required merely to speak quietly amid ordinary active freight yard, no direct detection/alert/authority claim. Worker presents but DOES NOT transfer a personal folded copied duty allocation sheet, with heading Station Kestrel — Veteran Recovery Facility, assignment of 11 patients across ordinary/secure wards, ordinary handling supplies for three immobile patients and director's office listed as DIRECTOR CORVEN NASK; this is one already prepared actual witness copy, not a newly discovered signed criminal order, trial instructions or full patient register. The attendant has personally made supply deliveries inside the compound and testifies: six patients awake/mobile, three cannot walk, two separately restrained; observed painful procedures despite spoken nonconsent. They cannot swear patients' prior legal charges or that all military staff knew, and the copy proves facility, staff assignment and ward logistics rather than proving wrongful abuse by itself. Cirren independently notes distinction between real paperwork and independently proving coercion; worker agrees patients/witnesses or site evidence would corroborate. The worker gives actual route description as far as firsthand logistics: from Caer Veylan's northern receiving road 24 road miles north, then8 rough cart-capable service-track miles northwest, total roughly32 road miles from Caer Veylan, 1⅔ typical unloaded road/travel days, slower with transported patients; not a side entrance on this current Eastwatch road and not an instant detour. The facility is an official guarded military administration/recovery compound, but exact defender abilities/secret lab truth/named godslaying cause not revealed or claimed as public. Cirren independently warns V that outright military attack could have consequences and no presumption that every official knows abuses; worker acknowledges prior belief in legitimate recovery. Worker offers actual itinerary and firsthand account for V to decide about, not asking revenge and not falsely promising money, official protection or state-wide enemy status. The duty sheet remains KN-S1's possession at end; no actual handoff/photocopy or record export, no caravan contract revised, no new consent from Sella for diversion. Elen Turr civil fittings already released, Sergeant Vos processing his two genuinely military empty cases elsewhere. Day279 approx10:20; no dice, attack, spells, abilities, time-consuming investigative ritual, inventory/coin/supply transfer. V48/48 HP HD7/7 full Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 and Fighter resources, Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 full L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3, Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy, four owned healthy horses and intact coach, purse969gp3sp6cp, provisions18 ration-person-days/24 horse-feed animal-days, sole sealed unused Pixie Dust, LongRest3/6. No Day279 new random occurrence (prior actual daytime d10090), future overnight or ongoing civilian arrest. entries.source_evidence:
Exact player speech and directive at Day279 ~10:20 after Station Kestrel support worker KN-S1's firsthand warning and shown copied duty allocation (Director Corven Nask, eleven persons, three immobile, two restrained, Kestrel veteran recovery station, 24mi north then8mi NW from Caer Veylan): "Shit… we have to at least look. And if they are committing atrocities… then I am sure someone in Crownsunder and Osavern would want to know". This is acceptance of LIMITED INVESTIGATION/RECONNAISSANCE into Kestrel's reported nonconsensual procedures, not automatic consent to a direct raid, fighting all Veyr, hostage rescue, torturing officers, revealing private knowledge to Harrow & Pike, purchasing/hiring escorts, entering wards, stealing papers, sharing evidence to foreign governments, abandoning their coach or deciding an exact route/departure time without V. V identifies potential Crownsunder and Ossent/Orsaven audience ONLY if independently corroborated evidence of atrocities is found. Workman KN-S1 responds with relief; he truthfully says there is an ordinary daytime public receiving interview at outer Kestrel administration but not unrestricted access to guarded wards, and he has official supply duties returning TWO already assigned empty military cases and cannot promise to smuggle V in, shield consequences or accompany a detour. Worker still retains his personal duty copy; no item transfer or detailed route map paper received by V. Cirren independently says Crownsunder/Ossent institutions might have genuine reasons to heed verified evidence but could have their own political interests, recommends distinguishing truth and sources from opportunism. Mara prioritizes victims' protection over using evidence to escalate interstate conflict. Fenar favors seeing facts first rather than declaring war on Veyr; does not assume all soldiers guilty. Sella Brant independently concludes normal inspections of her company's three freight wagons and calls to V from her nearly ready eastbound convoy asking whether things are all right; she has NOT been told of allegations, has NOT agreed to halt company business, undertake north Kestrel expedition or substitute as ally. All interactions take ~5 minutes, Day279 ~10:25 AM, existing public freight yard, eastward road open, party's coach/four horses available. Kestrel route is **32 road miles from Caer Veylan's north receiving road** (24 N+8 NW rough cart-capable track, approx1⅔ ordinary unloaded travel days from Caer Veylan, or2days with patients/stops); the party's current eastbound yard is a different road and no shortcut/distance directly from yard to the northern road is guaranteed. No actual new road movement, turning point selection, supplies debited, encounter roll, combat, deception, papers stolen or accepted official escort. No new promise of reward or guaranteed response from Crownsunder/Orsaven.
Resources unchanged: V48/48 HP HD7/7 AC19 full MP7/7 Psi6/6 Sup4/4 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1, Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 full spell slots 4/4 3/3 3/3 ChannelDivinity2/2, Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy; four V-owned healthy horses and sound coach; purse969gp3sp6cp, rations18 person-days, horse feed24 animal-days, one unopened V-owned Pixie Dust, weighted LongRest3/6.
